name: Punta Este
summary: Punta Este is Mexicali's premier mixed-use lifestyle destination, featuring the city's tallest tower with corporate offices, upscale dining, and entertainment in the prestigious Golden Zone. This cosmopolitan development offers panoramic views, gourmet restaurants specializing in Italian, Mexican, and Mediterranean cuisine, and a sophisticated atmosphere perfect for business and leisure.
demographics: Punta Este attracts an affluent, professional demographic in Mexicali's Golden Zone, primarily consisting of business executives, entrepreneurs, and upper-middle-class families aged 30-55 with above-average household incomes. The mixed-use development draws office workers during weekday business hours and upscale diners and social gatherings during evenings and weekends. The trade area serves Mexicali's most economically developed district, appealing to cosmopolitan consumers seeking premium dining experiences, international business environments, and sophisticated entertainment options in a modern urban setting.
description: Punta Este represents Mexicali's first integrated urban development combining a corporate office tower, hotel, and commercial plaza in the heart of the city's prestigious Golden Zone. Rising 67 meters as the tallest tower in Mexicali, this architectural landmark offers a cosmopolitan experience where business professionals can conduct international meetings, savor gourmet cuisine, or enjoy craft beers while taking in panoramic city views. The commercial plaza features an exceptional selection of Italian, Mexican, and Mediterranean restaurants and bars within versatile, strategically-oriented spaces that maximize the outdoor microclimate and stunning vistas. Developed by Hermosillo and Inmobiliaria Cawomex, Punta Este embodies sustainable, intelligent building design with cutting-edge global technology, neutral color palettes, and detailed finishes that harmonize with the natural environment. This vanguard destination provides a unique networking portal with international projection, offering a family-friendly atmosphere for social gatherings alongside premium office spaces ranging from 50 square meters, complete with covered parking, corporate terraces, and exclusive common areas.
